title: The Lighthouse · 9
paragraphs: [The sea without a stain on it, Lily Briscoe thought, still standing there gazing out across the bay. The sea lies stretched like silk across the bay. Distance had an extraordinary power: they had been swallowed up by it, she felt; they were gone for good; they had become part of the nature of things. Everything was so calm, so quiet. The steamer itself had disappeared, but its great scroll of smoke still hung in the air, drooping mournfully like a flag in farewell.]
